detail.longDescription: Today, with # claude I dove back into # python . So I covered the import mechanism and the reason for __main__ which I had an inkling. Argv list from sys, rounded it out. Nowhere near proficient, but further along than I was before. So that’s my win. # programming # LLM # TorchesAndPitchforks # MonsterGroan
